addedFacts.name: Step Away from the Maw
addedFacts.text.effect: If this terrain feature has a Head Butcher that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Head Butcher on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Head Butcher.

addedFacts.name: Obliterating Blast
addedFacts.text.declare: If this unit has not used a Run or Retreat ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target. Then, draw a straight line between the closest points on the bases of this unit and the target. Each other unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across is a collateral damage target.
addedFacts.text.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict D3 damage on each collateral damage target.

addedFacts.name: The First Shot's Mine!
addedFacts.text.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
addedFacts.text.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly Beastclaw units that target that enemy unit.
